annotations.title: Next steps for a faith journey (six journeys, end to end)

description: Run one of six common multi-step requests in a single call and return at most five ranked results across sources (churches, communities, gatherings, people available, Serve needs, plans, Scripture), each with why it fits and a freshness label, plus one next-step link. Journeys and their key input: community_near_me (place), someone_to_pray_with_tonight (place optional), serve_this_weekend (place), new_to_christianity (place optional), prayer_group_in_my_language (language), understand_and_live_a_passage (passage). Use when the request matches a journey and the person wants a short curated answer; for full lists use the single-purpose tools (find_churches_near, find_gatherings_near, needs_near, scripture_context). Empty journeys return empty true with alternatives. Reads live data and steps_taken lists every source consulted. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.

journey.description: Which journey to run: community_near_me, someone_to_pray_with_tonight, serve_this_weekend, new_to_christianity, prayer_group_in_my_language, understand_and_live_a_passage.

language.description: For prayer_group_in_my_language: language name or ISO 639-1 code ("Spanish", "es", "Korean").

place.description: City, region or country as the person says it ("Leeds", "Kenya"); never a street address. Used by the place-based journeys.

name: journey_next_steps

alternatives.description: Other links to try when results are thin.

attribution.description: Credit line for the data: The Living Bread (living-bread.org).

content_layers.description: Which fields are Scripture and which are human interpretation or reflection.

empty.description: True when nothing fitting was found.

evidence.description: Present when Scripture was read: translation, canon, corpus version, attribution, and a SHA-256 per passage.

freshness.description: How current the answer is: kind (scheduled | recently_observed | verified_live | record), retrieved_at, available_now (true only when activity was verified live).

honest.description: When empty or thin, a plain statement of what is missing; else null.

ids.description: Up to 25 ids found in this answer, for follow-up calls.

license.description: License URL of the returned data (CC BY 4.0 unless stated).

next_actions.description: Up to 4 links the person can open next.

next_step.description: The single recommended next link; give it exactly as returned.

ok.description: Always true on a successful answer (errors come back as isError, never here).

result_state.description: "empty" when nothing matched (count 0, no results); the text then says so plainly.

results.description: Ranked results: id, kind (church, community, gathering, people, need, reading_plan, scripture, page, door, act), title, why it fits, and source URL; each also carries freshness.

source_url.description: The first public web page this answer came from or points to.

visibility.description: "public" for shared data, "yours" for the signed-in believer's own data.

title: Next steps for a faith journey (six journeys, end to end)
